scripts.build: rslib build --root packages/core && rslib build --root packages/browser && rslib build --root packages/node
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const name of ['core', 'browser', 'node']) for (const path of ['dist', '.tsbuildinfo']) rmSync('packages/' + name + '/' + path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.demo: yarn build && yarn workspace demo-react-fullstack dev
scripts.demo:build: yarn build && yarn workspace demo-react-fullstack build
scripts.demo:test:e2e: yarn demo:build && yarn workspace demo-react-fullstack test:e2e
